spec_match.rationale: Builds the real WebTransportOptions dictionary (congestionControl + requireUnreliable + allowPooling) and runs the actual constructor with attribute samples at construction/ready/closed.

interactive.rationale: Select, URL field, two checkboxes drive a generated-code block, a copy button, and a real connection attempt with a timed step table.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises composing the real options object and watching ready/closed settle; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Constructor-throw branch, establishment-failure branch, and attribute-missing branch all have distinct honest copy.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/<id> plus the exact spec anchor in see-also.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite applies (see feature conformance.json); the injected support panel renders on this page and executed 8/8 assertions.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified on headless Chromium 141 (predates Chrome 158, feature absent even behind --enable-experimental-web-platform-features) via Playwright 1.56 at desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch, driving every control; screenshots under /tmp/claude-0/agentB/shots/. Clicking connect produced a real 'WebTransportError: Opening handshake failed' against the public echo endpoint (QUIC is blocked by this sandbox's proxy: ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED in console), surfaced verbatim; an established session could not be produced here.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert covers the primary contract and the explicit fallback branch; console output is intentional and prefixed.

design_system.rationale: Only CSS variables from public/styles.css; buttons overriding background also set color; AA pairs (text-charcoal/bg-stone, bg-ivory/text-black, accent-emerald-dark on paper).

accessibility.rationale: Native controls with labels, visible focus (verified first-Tab), caption+scope tables, aria-live polite result regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Both viewports exercised; generated code block scrolls horizontally inside its bordered pre.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the supported path on a real Chrome 158 / Canary build
openQuestions.detail: This environment's Chromium 141 lacks the surface even behind --enable-experimental-web-platform-features, so only the honest-absent branch ran. On Chrome 158 (or Canary with the feature's runtime flag) verify: that transport.congestionControl reflects the grant immediately and persists across ready resolution on an established session.

openQuestions.title: Exercise an established session against a reachable WebTransport echo server
openQuestions.detail: The sandbox's HTTP proxy cannot tunnel QUIC, so the default echo endpoint fails at handshake. From an unproxied network, verify the builder's established branch (ready resolved row plus granted preference readout) against echo.webtransport.day:4433 or a local HTTP/3 server.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native labelled controls with adequate touch targets and visible hints for constraints.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All controls are native button/select/input/radio elements with <label for> associations, min-height 44px, and inline constraint hints.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsically-sized grid/flex layouts (auto-fit + minmax) so panels reflow without horizontal overflow at narrow widths.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Control panels use grid-template-columns repeat(auto-fit, minmax()), tables are wrapped in overflow-x containers, and long tokens use overflow-wrap: anywhere; verified no horizontal overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Landmarks, native semantics, accessible names, visible focus, and polite live regions for asynchronous state changes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Content sits in main/header/footer landmarks; async results land in aria-live=polite output/status elements; tables carry caption plus th scope=col; first-Tab focus visibility verified in the browser.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce error/failure outcomes programmatically, not only visually.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Real API errors (name + message) are written into aria-live output regions and colour is never the only signal (text states the outcome).

summary: Real options composition and a real connection attempt with verbatim error surfacing; clipboard copy has a visible failure fallback.
